title.zh: 在北伊罗戈省Espiritu市镇设立若干村的法案
title.en: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Municipality of Espiritu in the Province of Ilocos Norte
title.orig: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Municipality of Espiritu in the Province of Ilocos Norte

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5585_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 3 条，缺 2）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。

text.en:
The following sitios in the Municipality of Espiritu, Province of Ilocos Norte, are constituted as bar­ios thereof, to wit:
1. The sitios of Santo Nino, San Pedro, Santa Maria, and Santa Ana in Barrio Caestehanan, and the sitio of San Jose in Barrio Capacacan, all in the Municipality of Espiritu, Province of Ilocos Norte, are separated from said barrios and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as Barrio San Simeon; and
2. The sitios of San Juan, Dispenza, and Nanamburan in Barrio Caribquib, Municipality of Espiritu, Province of Ilocos Norte, are separated from said barrio and con­stituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as Barrio Imelda.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
